ICS 23.020.35MED 16Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard deals with brazed low carbon steel cylinders intended for storage and transportation of low pressure liquefiable gases, other than toxic gases, of nominal capacity exceeding 500 ml but not exceeding 13 litres of water capacity. This standard lays down the minimum requirements for the materials, design, fabrication, construction, testing and marking on these cylinders2. REFERENCESThe standards given in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions to this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.
